title: Shimei
summary: Raleigh names Shimei in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Shimei of the house of Saul, also printed Semei, who cursed Dauid and afterward fetched his fugitiue seruant from Gath. He is not Simei ouer the vineyards. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XVII, §. VII, sig. 296b–297a
